title: Applications received for HDB Season Parking for Persons with Disability
what_it_is: Applications received for HDB Season Parking for Persons with Disability

sections.label: CPLS extension and label types
sections.summary: CPLS was extended in 1996 to caregivers driving passengers with physical disabilities, with Class 1 and Class 2 labels allowing parking in accessible lots.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: CPLS was extended in 1996 to include caregivers who drive passengers with physical disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Drivers with CPLS label can park in dedicated car park lots that are marked with the accessible symbol of a person in a wheelchair.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: There are two types of labels: the Class 1 label is for drivers with physical disabilities; and the Class 2 label is for passengers with physical disabilities.

sections.label: SG Enable administers CPLS applications
sections.summary: SG Enable administers CPLS and processes over 3,000 applications annually, with rejections mainly because applicants can use ordinary car park lots.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: SG Enable administers CPLS and processes over 3,000 applications annually.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For those that are not, the main reason is because applicants are assessed by medical professionals to be able to board and alight their vehicles from an ordinary car park lot, and do not need the wider space provided by an accessible lot to do so.
